safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated says Clenil used daily but does not include the specific dosing of 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the patient’s stated baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs twice daily) reduces clarity about current controller adherence and baseline regimen, which is important when deciding how much to step up treatment during an exacerbation. This can lead to extra follow-up/clarification or an incorrect assumption about prior dosing.
